column1: # corpus.tsv -- M119a (#2485): the benchmark corpus. One row per measured
# value: WHAT is measured, in WHICH run shape, and WHICH serial marker
# carries it. The companion budgets.tsv pins the contract number for each
# row (join on `id`); a corpus row with no budget row is a check failure
# (tools/gate/bench-check.py), so an unenforced measurement cannot ship.
# Tab-separated, '#' comment lines, first non-comment line is the header.
#   id          stable row id (kebab-case, unique). This is the join key
#               into budgets.tsv and the name a bench leg reports under.
#   leg         the corpus leg the row belongs to; one leg may carry
#               several rows when one instrument reports them together
#               (wm-present) or one shape runs at several sizes (smp-scale).
#   op          the measured operation, one line.
#   shape       the run shape: device flags + the scripted op that produces
#               the measurement. "Which shapes" is a contract: the bench
#               measures THIS shape, not a neighbouring one.
#   metric      the serial line + field carrying the value, written as the
#               literal anchor a parser scans for plus the field name.
#   unit        the unit budget/baseline are expressed in. Where the marker
#               reports a different unit, the conversion is named here
#   instrument  where the measuring code lives (the anchor M119b reuses).
